title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 202
paragraphs: Those Barcaeans most guilty of Arcesilaus's murder, when the Persians handed them over to her, Pheretime impaled in a ring around the wall; and she cut off the breasts of their wives and set these too around the wall in order. The rest of the people of Barca she ordered the Persians to carry off as spoil, except those who were of the house of Battus and who had had no share in the guilt of the murder; to these Pheretime gave the city in charge.
